name: Film — prerendered photoreal loops
cli: Blender -b --factory-startup --python run.py -- SPEC.json (--stills DIR | --still FILE | --anim DIR [--frames A-B] | --build-sequence DIR) [--variant V] [--camera C] [--engine cycles|eevee] [--res WxH] [--samples N] [--no-post]

protocol.progress: lines 'PROGRESS {json}': stage fetch|build|still|sample|frame, done, of, eta_s
protocol.result: final line 'RESULT {json}': ok, outputs, timings | ok=false, error

encode: python3 -I dsfilm/encode.py FRAMES_DIR OUT_BASE  ->  OUT_BASE.mov (HEVC main10 hvc1) + OUT_BASE-preview.mp4
licence_of_assets: CC0 only (Poly Haven, ambientCG); logged in <cache>/LICENSES.tsv
